item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 04/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the anticyclone aloft over southeastern China strengthening gradually, the weather will be mainly fine and very hot over the region for the rest of this week and early next week. Meanwhile, a southwesterly airstream will bring showers to the coast of Guangdong.

Date/Month: 05/07 (Wednesday)
Wind: Southwest force 4.
Weather: Sunny periods and a few showers. Hot during the day.
Temp range: 27 - 32 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low
